newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Caterpillar rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Caterpillar rating cut.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley equity analyst John Mackin said on Monday he lowered his rating on Caterpillar Inc to outperform from strong buy, based on the stock's price appreciation.
-- But Mackin raised his price target on the stock to $104 per share from $94 per share, because he said he still believed Caterpillar's stock price was headed higher.

-- "We still think the stock is going higher but we've started to take a little money off the table and sell into the rally," Mackin said. "Caterpillar's risen about 20 points in the past month and about 55 percent since July. The stock really doesn't owe people much."
